lines.text:
Got any plans?
Wanna listen to some music if you're free?

I may be into older things,
but that doesn't mean I'm an antique.
If you've got nothing to do, at least come and massage my back.

Everything gets better with age.
Have you got any old objects lying around?
I'd love to hear any music recommendations you have.

Live long.
Being alive is a blessing.
Take your time. I'll be here listening to some tunes.

I don't mind being alone,
as long as it's not for too long.

I like the Theater. 
I bet the acoustics in it must be amazing.

I'm a bit turned off by super modernized places like this.
It's a bit suffocating.

Goddess of Victory, and Wings of Victory...
Haha, I must say I'm quite proud of this.

I'm a relic from a bygone era, so I'll be leaving soon.
But, until that happens, I'll do everything I can to help.
Whoa, amazing!
Wow, I could have never imagined this happening in my time.
So this is how you get stronger these days? So convenient.
What is this? You're not pulling a prank on me, are you?
For me, it's all about the give and take. What kind of gift would you like?
Do you have any dirty mags?
You're a good person. You should continue living like that.
If I were a little bit younger, you'd be in big trouble.
Come here. Let's listen to music. We can split the earbuds.
Red Hood! Engage!
Mhmm.
Come on, let's go!
Are you ready? Then let's go.
Get lost! I'm busy.
You can leave this to me! Trust me!
Today sure isn't your lucky day.
Better reload.
Why don't they develop something like an infinite magazine?
Oh no, I was just getting into the groove.
Wolfsbane, ready!
Sorry to break it to you, but this is the end.
Let's keep the momentum going!
Right!
Good!
That was simple enough.
Touché.
What the...?!
Oh?
I'm sorry. I didn't keep my head in the game.
Did you see that? I'm strong, but my comrades are stronger!

What gorgeous weather! 
Days like this are perfect for listening to music outside. Wanna come?

Man, a cold beer would hit the spot right now. 
Reckon there's anyone who'll drink with me?

Wonder what the others are up to... 
Hmm. Shall I give them a call?

Wow... it's so peaceful.
Heh, never thought I'd say such a thing.

Feels good, spending time like this with you, Handsome.
This'll be a day I'll never forget.

How about it, Handsome?
Think we've gotten kinda close.

Ugh, being alone is so boring. 
Guess I'll go pester Handsome for fun.

Go on ahead, Handsome.
I'll just enjoy this beautiful day and listen to some music. It's been a while.

Hmm, this is the perfect place for an afternoon drink...
Oh, you heard that? Hehe, wanna join me, Handsome?

This feels like a great place to live. 
Almost makes me wanna bring everyone here.

I think we're done lookin' around here.
Why don't we check out your room, Handsome?

Mind if impose once more, Handsome? 
How about we listen to some music together?
Oh, wow. My body feels so much lighter.
Where did you even get all this? Thanks, Handsome!
So, what can I do for you first? Just say the word, I've got you.

Oh-ho, trying to charm me again?
Hehe. Thanks.
Need anything, Handsome? I'll buy it for you next time.
You're seriously giving me all this? Won't you be left with nothing?
You're a good guy, Handsome. Always have been.

Haha. Didn't think I'd get this attached.
You're really making it hard to walk away.
I feel like I can entrust everything I hold dear to you.
Had enough rest? Let's move.
Yeah. I'm listening.
All right then, let's go!
Hehehe. Look who it is, scoundrels!
Been a while since I had a proper fight!
Hehehe. My blood's pumping.
Trust me, I'll crush them all.
Heh! Guess I forgot how this is done!
Phew, no time for a breather at all.
Come on! One more round!
Handsome...!
Ahh... Life was great, wasn't it?
Hahaha. Let's hit the road running!
All right!
One down!
Next!
Damn it!
That hurts...
Look at that...
Heh, guess I've been slacking too much... My body feels stiff...
See? Told you everything would work out.

Ugh, this is so uncomfortable.
I shouldn't have worn this dress.
I've never been to a place like this before. I don't feel entirely comfortable, but it's quite nice.

What is up with this music? I thought this was supposed to be a party.
It's so grating... isn't there something else they could play?

Come on, let's all have a drink.
It's a day worth celebrating.

Hey girl, wanna dance with me later?
Haha! Just kidding, just kidding.

Come here! They're finally playing some oldies!
Now THIS kind of music is perfect for a party.

Is there nothing fun to do around here?
Where is everyone?

Mmm, this wine tastes good.
Gotta let Snow try some later.
Wow, so a place like this exists, huh?
There's way more stuff here than I imagined!

It's obvious that this place is well-managed.
They've clearly done a stellar job maintaining it.

When you're going to a party, your choice of garment says everything.
How do I look?

I feel a bit lighter.
Is it because this dress is made of thinner material?

Why do I feel so restless?
